blocks.html: Brighton Baliwag’s First &amp; Newest House Model: Madison

Robinsons Homes celebrated another milestone for Brighton Baliwag. Slated to be one of the most prominent developments in Bulacan, Brighton Baliwag recently unveiled the first among five model units, Madison.This was followed by the groundbreaking of its village clubhouse. Future homeowners can have a glimpse of style and comfort complemented by recreational amenities that this sprawling enclave can offer.

Located 45 minutes away from the hustle and bustle of the metro, this 15-hectare, Contemporary Mediterranean-inspired subdivision is a master-planned development whichboasts of design themes to suit the varying taste of Filipinos, withhomes perfect for start-up to growing families.

The Bright House Collection offers five models houses that range from 71sqm. - 118sqm. in size. Each house design caters to the different lifestyle choices of future homeownerssuch as functional floor layouts and thoughtfully designed ventilation and lighting for energy efficiency.
Interested clients may start viewing the Madison model unit while the other model units will be unveiled by December 2015.
